findings.location: capsule-6746514/code/wave_test.py:84
findings.evidence: MinMaxScaler.fit_transform is called before the first split (line 87); if it sees test data, information leaks into training.

findings.location: PCC_WFE.py:29-45; NewData_ML_Kfold.py:51-52
findings.evidence: [G2] Are inclusion/exclusion rules stated, with counts removed at each step? -> not_reported. No inclusion/exclusion rules are documented. The code silently drops 124 of 178 channels (negative PCC) and collapses classes 2-5 into 'non-seizure'; neither step is described in any text.

findings.location: NewData_ML_Kfold.py:17,29; SGRU_GRU_Kfold.py
findings.evidence: [M1] Are random seeds stated, and are results reported over several seeds? -> not_reported. No random seed is set anywhere; XGBoost/RF/DT and the Keras models are unseeded, so a single run is not reproducible bit-for-bit. Also at: capsule-6746514/code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:17; capsule-6746514/code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:29; capsule-6746514/code/RawData_ML_Kfold.py:17; capsule-6746514/code/RawData_ML_Kfold.py:29; capsule-6746514/code/pca_test.py:23; capsule-6746514/code/pca_test.py:35; capsule-6746514/code/wave_test.py:23; capsule-6746514/code/wave_test.py:35.

findings.location: NewData_ML_Kfold.py:39; SGRU_GRU_Kfold.py:50
findings.evidence: [M3] How was the data split, and does the split respect groups (patients, compositions, scaffolds, time, sites)? -> not_reported. Plain sklearn KFold(n_splits=10) with no shuffle and no grouping. The UCI file has no patient/segment identifier, so whether the 23 five-second segments of one 23.6-s recording can fall in different folds cannot be checked from the materials.

findings.location: PCC_WFE.py:24-67; NewData_ML_Kfold.py:36
findings.evidence: [M4] Were preprocessing steps (scaling, feature selection, imputation, PCA) fitted on training data only? -> not_reported. PCC-WFE weights and the MinMaxScaler are fitted once on all 11500 samples before KFold, so every test fold contributes to the feature construction and to the scaling range.

findings.location: NewData_ML_Kfold.py:16-30
findings.evidence: [M5] Are hyperparameter search space, budget and selection criterion stated (selected on validation, not test)? -> not_reported. Hyper-parameters are fixed constants with no search space, budget or selection criterion; no tuning is described.

findings.location: data/Epileptic Seizure Recognition.csv
findings.evidence: [M7] Were duplicates and near-duplicates between training and test sets removed? -> not_reported. No de-duplication step; the UCI file has no identifier column, so duplicate segments cannot be detected.

findings.location: PCC_WFE.py:29-45
findings.evidence: [M10] If the paper credits specific features or descriptors for the performance, is there a negative control (random or shuffled features, one-hot identity encoding, y-randomisation)? -> not_reported. No negative control for the PCC-WFE feature (no shuffled-label or random-weight feature). The added feature is a fixed linear combination of the same 178 channels, so its contribution is not isolated from the raw channels.

findings.location: capsule-6746514/code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:12 vs capsule-6746514/code/perform.py
findings.evidence: Metric definitions (deep_checks.py): sensitivity/precision come from sklearn with recall_score average='macro' in one pipeline (capsule-6746514/code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:12 recall_score average='macro'; capsule-6746514/code/NewData_ML_Kfold.py:13 precision_score average='macro'; capsule-6746514/code/RawData_ML_Kfold.py:12 recall_score average='macro') and from a binary TP/(TP+FN), TP/(TP+FP) count for one class in another (capsule-6746514/code/perform.py, code/perform.py). Values with the same name are not the same quantity, so a table comparing them across methods is not like for like.

findings.location: capsule-6746514/code/SGRU_GRU_Kfold.py
findings.evidence: Pipeline coverage (deep_checks.py): capsule-6746514/code/SGRU_GRU_Kfold.py trains GRU, SGRU, which no script of the entry point (capsule-6746514/code/run, code/run) trains; the entry point never runs it and the stored output has no lines from it. The figure scripts plot numbers for GRU, SGRU as typed-in literals, so those numbers cannot be traced to a stored run.
